Noah T: Hi, my spouse is now covered by their new employer. I want to remove them from our medical but leave them on vision/dental. Midyear change possible?

Rina (People Ops): Yes, that's a QLE. Submit proof within 31 days. You can remove dependent from specific plans — choose which plans to change on the portal.

Noah T: What proof works? Enrollment portal is behind login.

Rina (People Ops): A screenshot showing name, employer, and effective date is fine. Or an enrollment confirmation email. Upload under 'Dependent change (QLE)'.

Payroll Bot: Payroll cutoff is the 20th for the next cycle. If People Ops approves before cutoff, deductions stop the next pay period. Refunds for past paychecks are rare and reviewed case-by-case.

Noah T: Uploaded screenshot and selected medical only. Thanks.

Rina (People Ops): Got it. Case BEN-2026-410 opened. We'll verify with the carrier and update here within 3 business days.
